description: This file defines a data transfer object class `ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams` used for handling filter parameters related to review KPI searches within the OrangeHRM performance module. It extends a base filter parameter class and includes properties for review ID and reviewer group name, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReviewKpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for specifying search filters related to KPI reviews, including properties for review ID and reviewer group name, with default sorting set to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class and sets the default sort field to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Returns the reviewer group name filter parameter.

methods.name: setReviewerGroupName
methods.description: Sets the reviewer group name filter parameter.
